name: labs/ombayley__chemklipper
title: ChemKlipper CoreXY gantry (chem_klipper.devices.gantry:Gantry)
intro: ChemKlipper CoreXY gantry (chem_klipper.devices.gantry:Gantry), adapted from ombayley/chemklipper. It reads `connected`, `status`, `position` and `target_position`; runs `home_gantry`, `move_cartesian` and `stop_motion`. `home_gantry`: home all gantry axes with the native G28. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
